title: Source Inventory, Scale Taxonomy & Authority Map

resolved_contract.scale_rule: Scale labels are aggregation/coordination roles, not universal numeric caps. Only individual references canonical constituent truth; SCL-02 owns later membership/composition/profile definitions.
resolved_contract.projection_rule: Up-scale projection carries explicit canonical constituent ids, owner references and provenance and does not copy or fork authoritative Character, Asset, inventory, Vehicle, damage, casualty, Event, Organization, Economy or World state.
resolved_contract.reconciliation_rule: SCL-01 performs no down-scale mutation. Later results reconcile through explicit owner-domain proposals/commits; SCL-09 is primary for casualty/damage reconciliation and may not double-apply effects.
resolved_contract.handoff_rule: SCL-03/04 own future command/order/resolution; SCL-08 owns future platform/fleet integration; SCL-09 owns individual-to-unit effects; SCL-10 owns owner-domain strategic consequence integration.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Permission/visibility filtering occurs before source/projection inclusion, counts, aggregation, summaries, search, provenance, deterministic receipts or AI context. Hidden existence and hidden cardinality remain undisclosed.
resolved_contract.unknown_conflict_rule: Missing, hidden, conflicting or identity-incompatible evidence remains explicit unknown/conflict/incompatible and is never auto-reconciled or promoted to authority.
resolved_contract.ai_rule: SCL-01 invokes no provider and grants AI no command, order, adjudication, permission, mutation or completion authority.
resolved_contract.persistence: No durable SCL-01 ledger or migration; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
